11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

1241|9a68c288.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|9a68c288.text: Good day to ye lass. Can I be of service?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1466|8a39834c.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|8a39834c.text: This hide isn't ready to work with yet. I wish it didn't take so long to make leather. There has to be some way to cut down on all this waiting. It can't be good for my health, you know?

1466|9e43c86b.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|9e43c86b.text: Aww, what rotten luck! My skills aren't good enough to be of any use to you. Oh well. Talk to Fimble Finespindle over there by the loom. He's been working with leather for longer than I have.

1466|f7f23ddc.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|f7f23ddc.text: Oh, goody, something else to do while I wait! You're a real life-saver, $N!

14723|240f95e3.name: Mistina Steelshield
14723|240f95e3.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

5127|62ce6712.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|62ce6712.text: Lots to do! Haven't been this busy since my cousin accidentally vaporized all the cloth and leather in Gnomeregan. My, it was drafty for a while! Ah, $N, those were the days....

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|e17c4c95.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e17c4c95.text: Sure ye don't want to be a Blacksmith?  Well, if yer heart is set on Leatherworking, then you best talk to Fimble Finespindle over at his shop on the northwest side of The Great Forge.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

287-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-accept.text:
I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $N. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.

Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
287-accept.title: Frostmane Hold

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

291-complete.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-complete.text:
<He quickly peruses the report.>

Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
291-complete.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

308-complete.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-complete.text: For me? You're a true hero, $N!
308-complete.title: Distracting Jarven

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-accept.name: Marleth Barleybrew
310-accept.text:
I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...
310-accept.title: Bitter Rivals

310-complete.name: Unknown
310-complete.text: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
310-complete.title: Bitter Rivals

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

311-accept.name: Unknown
311-accept.text: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
311-accept.title: Return to Marleth

311-complete.name: Marleth Barleybrew
311-complete.text:
Not bad, $N! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?

No matter--many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
311-complete.title: Return to Marleth

312-accept.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-accept.text:
I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season.  Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it!  But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker.  He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though.  But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.

You seem a bit more stealthy than me.  Perhaps you can retrieve my stash?  I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
312-accept.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

312-complete.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-complete.text: What a kind soul you are, $N!  Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
312-complete.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

315-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-accept.text:
I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout.  I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood.  I just need to find the right recipe...

The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east.  They use it in their strange, tribal rituals.  We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!

Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.
315-accept.title: The Perfect Stout

315-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-complete.text: Great!  I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes.  There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
315-complete.title: The Perfect Stout

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

318-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
318-complete.text: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine?  Hm...all right.
318-complete.title: Evershine

319-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-accept.text:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor?  Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows.  Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting $r would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
319-accept.title: A Favor for Evershine

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

384-complete.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-complete.text:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
384-complete.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

403-complete.name: Unknown
403-complete.text: This barrel of ale is guarded by Jarven Thunderbrew.  As long as he's in the basement, no barrels may be disturbed.
403-complete.title: Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel

412-accept.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-accept.text:
Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.

Ozzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
412-accept.title: Operation Recombobulation

413-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
413-accept.text:
I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout.  He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
413-accept.title: Shimmer Stout

5541-complete.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-complete.text:
Great, more ammo!  Old Loslor's shipment finally came through!  The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!

Thank you much, $N.  I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
5541-complete.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

96056-complete.name: Balthus Stoneflayer
96056-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96056-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lass? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain
